deadline.value: Applications for self-proposed research are accepted all year round, with 1 June recommended for September entry and early spring for funding.
deadline.quote: If you are submitting your own research proposal, applications are accepted all year round. However, if you wish to start in September, we would strongly encourage you to apply by 1 June.

entry_route.value: A 2:1 UK Honours degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant discipline.

supervisor.value: Applicants proposing their own research can suggest potential supervisors, but can also apply without naming one.
supervisor.quote: When you apply, you can suggest one or two potential supervisors, who you think might be a good fit for you. However, this is not essential.

funding.value: A limited number of scholarships and studentships may be available to outstanding applicants.
funding.quote: A limited number of scholarships and studentships may be available to outstanding applicants.

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject Test is not stated or required for postgraduate research admission at Birmingham.

notes: Postgraduate research programme (Pure Mathematics PhD) in the School of Mathematics at the University of Birmingham.
